old_problem: SBR operates on a secondary-bus subtree, not an abstract GPU. Without the upstream bridge, sibling blast radius, quiesce, assertion/deassertion and return contract, a wrong hierarchy can reset unrelated devices and a recovered final snapshot can hide earlier scope or recovery failures.
disposition_reason: The source unambiguously requires SBR Hot Reset via NVQual Test #24. Exact bridge/subtree, iterations, timing, quiesce, identity-complete restoration and out-of-band recovery are runtime Project Configuration. Hot reset remains distinct from FLR, link toggle, reboot or power cycle, so review can resolve without inventing an interchangeable substitute.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2127, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2128 / Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00005-V002 / 4e1b296ff35ea6f3 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Bind the exact NVQual Test #24 revision and upstream bridge/secondary-bus/root-port/switch/retimer/endpoint/GPU/sibling topology before any reset write.
Quiesce all consumers and preserve/hash pre-test logs/inventories rather than clearing them. Record stable endpoint identities independent of BDF changes.

Treat every SBR as an atomic transaction: pre-state, assertion, expected in-scope disappearance, out-of-scope sibling continuity, deassertion, retrain/re-enumeration, required link, driver/GPU readiness and fresh errors by deadline.
Iteration count and timing are signed project inputs; the 600-minute source allocation remains and cannot be replaced by a short smoke run.

Stop on wrong-scope reset, failed/late retrain, missing/misbound/downtrained endpoint, sibling effect, driver/GPU failure, hang/unplanned reboot, disqualifying AER/reset, artifact gap or safety anomaly.
Never escalate a failed hot reset to forced rescan/rebind, host reboot or power cycle as if it were the same result; preserve first fault and use only signed recovery without retry.
No NVQual/SBR, reset write, link/device query, log clearing, rescan/rebind, reboot, power cycle, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.test_name: Scoped identity-complete HGX NVQual Test #24 SBR Hot Reset interoperability
test_case.purpose: Prove each approved SBR affects only the intended secondary-bus subtree and returns all expected NVIDIA endpoints at required link and functional health without hang, unplanned host reboot or disqualifying errors.
required_package: Pinned NVIDIA NVQual Test #24 SBR package/configuration with compatible firmware/driver
Signed upstream bridge/secondary-bus/root-port/switch/retimer/endpoint/GPU/sibling topology and stable identity map
Signed iteration count/timing, durable atomic reset ledger and first-fault interlock
Dedicated idle HGX SUT, BMC/console, stable power/cooling and out-of-band recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration is signed. Export/hash baseline logs and complete topology/inventory. After point approval run only the pinned Test #24 SBR primitive on the mapped bridge; per iteration durably record pre-state, assertion/deassertion, affected identities, sibling continuity, retrain/re-enumeration, link generation/width, driver/GPU readiness, timing and error/health deltas before another reset. Stop on first anomaly; do not rescan, rebind, reboot, power-cycle or retry.
test_case.expected_result: Every approved SBR transaction is contained to the intended subtree, expected endpoints disappear and return by deadline with stable identities and required links/functions, out-of-scope siblings remain healthy, all Test #24 items pass, and no hang, unplanned host reboot or disqualifying errors occur.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until Test #24 manifest, bridge/subtree/sibling scope, quiesce/reset/return contract, iterations and recovery are approved. PASS requires every complete accepted SBR transaction. FAIL on wrong scope, failed/late return, missing/misbound/downtrained device, sibling/driver/GPU failure, hang/reboot, disqualifying error or failed recovery. Missing input/artifact is BLOCKED; escalation/retry cannot erase failure.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until exact SBR bridge/subtree, blast radius, quiesce, timing/acceptance, ledger/interlock and recovery are signed.
Preserve baseline evidence; validate bridge ownership before any write.
Use an isolated idle SUT with console and explicit reset authorization.
Stop without rescan/rebind, reboot/power escalation or retry on the first scope, restoration or evidence anomaly.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, owner-approved Test #24 manifest/configuration and authorization
HGX/tool/firmware/driver/BMC identities plus complete bridge/bus/sibling/endpoint/GPU stable-identity topology
First-fault/out-of-band recovery or clean final topology/link/device/host state, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: At wrong-scope reset, failed/late retrain, missing/misbound/downtrained device, sibling/driver/GPU impact, hang/reboot, disqualifying error or artifact gap, inhibit later resets and preserve the first event. Do not force rescan/rebind or substitute reboot/power cycle; follow signed out-of-band recovery and quarantine if expected topology/health is not restored.
